launch_manifest.note: Everything a model switch would change. A switch is a dated amendment to this block (plus a budget entry for the new qualification set), then a fresh S0, a fresh reviewer approval and a fresh S1-Q on new worlds. No code changes.
launch_manifest.price_note: Claude Sonnet 4.6 list price, USD 3 input and USD 15 output per million tokens; the model the market-split study ran on 2026-10-04

provider.boundary: src/adapter.py AnthropicAdapter (native Messages API over HTTPS, standard library only)
provider.structured_output: output_config.format json_schema, one fixed schema per phase
provider.prompt_caching: not requested; any reported cache usage is a failure
provider.thinking_rule: launch_manifest.thinking: off sends no thinking field; budget sends thinking {type: enabled, budget_tokens: N}, adds N to max_tokens for every call and omits temperature (the API does not accept a temperature with thinking enabled)

retry.scope: only a request the provider rejected before running the model (rate limit or overload); all attempts and waits share the one 60 second request budget; timeouts and every other failure are never retried

budget.shared_allowance_note: inside dmarz's USD 500 total API allowance for all experiments

s1r_clean_competence.note: focal public final answer correct in clean-regime replay episodes; below this the team prompts are suspect and S1-L does not start
